description: Implement draft-ietf-jmap-tasks-06 extension trait over jmap-base-client. JmapTasksExt adds 14 typed methods: task_list_get, task_list_changes, task_list_set (TaskListSetRequest with onDestroyRemoveTasks), task_get, task_changes, task_set, task_copy (TaskCopyRequest with fromAccountId), task_query (TaskQueryRequest), task_query_changes (TaskQueryChangesRequest), task_notification_get, task_notification_changes, task_notification_set/destroy (takes &[Id], destroy-only), task_notification_query, task_notification_query_changes. Spec: draft-ietf-jmap-tasks-06. Pattern: jmap-chat-client. Blocked by: jmap-tasks-types epic.
title: jmap-tasks-client: JMAP Tasks client methods
